_comment: ApprovalReason, the form ApprovalReject and ApprovalRevoke prompt with through a retry, shipped by
MintPlayer.Spark.Approvals. A virtual prompt type: no clrType, no documents, no rights needed, never a page of
its own. The engine refuses an empty reason whatever the form let through.
HAND-AUTHORED. The ids are UUIDv5 of 'approvals:ApprovalReason[.attributes.<Name>]' (D5), verified by SPARK045.
